summary: Tested LUMI logo rendering and dark mode accessibility fixes. All features working correctly. Logo icon-only crops render properly (512x287 dimensions), dark mode text is WHITE and visible on dark background, chat area uses lumi-light-panel scoping for dark text on white background.
critical_code_review_comments: LumiBrand component correctly uses icon-only crops (lumi-icon-only.png, lumi-icon-only-transparent.png) that render at 512x287 pixels without chopping
Dark mode text visibility fixed by restructuring LumiMessenger: dashboard renders in bg-[#0D1117] container, chat area wraps in lumi-light-panel
CSS scoping rule (html.dark .lumi-light-panel) correctly limits dark text override to actual light-background panels only
Theme toggle button (data-testid='theme-toggle-btn') correctly toggles html.dark class
context_for_next_testing_agent: Logo and dark mode fixes verified. LumiBrand uses icon-only PNG crops at /lumi-icon-only.png and /lumi-icon-only-transparent.png. Dashboard bento tiles have WHITE text in dark mode (rgb(255,255,255)). Chat area correctly scoped with lumi-light-panel class.
